#Swiss-Prot Hits
```{r}
# Genes from 5_gene_clusters.Rmd
tx2gene <- fread("reference/clusters/tx2gene_nvir_clusters.csv.gz")

# Best Swiss-Prot hit of each transcript (package_inputs.R). Hits without an entry-name symbol are empty
swissprot <- fread("build/input/swissprot/swissprot_hits.csv.gz", na.strings = c("", "NA"))

# The Sandberg contigs of Myf5, Myog and Myf6 with their Swiss-Prot hit (Abdullayev et al. 2013). Their columns are shifted: aling_length holds the E-value, evalue the bit score
mrf <- fread("build/input/sandberg_mrf/sandberg_mrf_annotation.csv") %>%
  transmute(txid = target_id,
            protein = str_remove(sacc, "RecName: Full="),
            accession = UNIPROT_swissp,
            evalue = aling_length,
            pident = pident,
            bitscore = evalue,
            SYMBOL_mrf = SYMBOL_merged)

tx <- tx2gene %>%
  select(txid = TXNAME, GENEID) %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(swissprot, mrf), by = "txid")

# Gene names and GO terms of the hit proteins from UniProt (fetch_uniprot_go.py). The 13 lines with a single field are obsolete accessions
uniprot <- fread("build/input/uniprot/uniprot_go.tsv", fill = TRUE, na.strings = "") %>%
  filter(!is.na(reviewed))
```


#Symbols
```{r}
# Best hit of each gene: the member hit with the lowest E-value (ties: highest bit score)
best <- tx %>%
  filter(!is.na(accession)) %>%
  arrange(evalue, desc(bitscore), txid) %>%
  distinct(GENEID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(uniprot, by = "accession")

# Symbol: the UniProt gene name of the best hit (the first if several), else the symbol of its entry name (e.g. ACTS), in sentence case with "-" for "_".
# Myf5, Myog and Myf6 by their annotation, genes without a gene name keep their ID
best <- best %>%
  mutate(symbol = coalesce(na_if(str_remove(gene_primary, ";.*"), ""), entry_symbol) %>%
           str_to_sentence() %>%
           str_replace_all("_", "-"),
         symbol = coalesce(SYMBOL_mrf, symbol, GENEID))

# Genes that share a symbol: the best E-value keeps it, the others get .2, .3 ... in E-value order
best <- best %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL = if_else(row_number() == 1, symbol, paste0(symbol, ".", row_number()))) %>%
  ungroup()
```


#GO Terms
```{r}
# GO terms of the hit proteins of all members, transferred by sequence similarity (ISS). No electronic (IEA) annotation is used
uniprot_go <- uniprot %>%
  filter(!is.na(go_ids)) %>%
  select(accession, GO = go_ids) %>%
  separate_rows(GO, sep = "; ")

go <- tx %>%
  filter(!is.na(accession)) %>%
  distinct(GENEID, accession) %>%
  inner_join(uniprot_go, by = "accession", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  distinct(GENEID, GO) %>%
  mutate(EVIDENCE = "ISS") %>%
  arrange(GENEID, GO)

fwrite(go, "reference/clusters/go_nvir_clusters.csv.gz")
```


#Gene Table
```{r}
# All hit proteins of each gene
uniprot_ids <- tx %>%
  filter(!is.na(accession)) %>%
  distinct(GENEID, accession) %>%
  group_by(GENEID) %>%
  summarise(UNIPROT = paste(accession, collapse = "; "))

# One row per gene. Gene name: the protein name of the best hit without alternative names (after ";") and species (the bracket at the end), else "-"
genes <- tx %>%
  distinct(GENEID) %>%
  left_join(best %>% select(GENEID, SYMBOL, protein, best_hit = accession, evalue), by = "GENEID") %>%
  left_join(uniprot_ids, by = "GENEID") %>%
  left_join(go %>% count(GENEID, name = "GO_n"), by = "GENEID") %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL = coalesce(SYMBOL, GENEID),
         GENENAME = coalesce(str_remove(protein, ";.*") %>% str_remove(" \\[(\\[[^\\]]*\\])?[^\\[\\]]*\\]$"), "-"),
         GO_n = replace_na(GO_n, 0L)) %>%
  select(GENEID, SYMBOL, GENENAME, UNIPROT, best_hit, evalue, GO_n)

fwrite(genes, "reference/clusters/annotation_nvir_clusters.csv.gz", na = "NA")

# One row per transcript: its gene and Swiss-Prot hit
tx %>%
  select(txid, GENEID, accession, evalue, pident) %>%
  fwrite("reference/clusters/annotation_nvir_clusters_tx.csv.gz", na = "NA")
```


```{r}
# Genes with a Swiss-Prot hit, a symbol and GO terms, and the number of GO terms
genes %>%
  summarise(genes = n(),
            swissprot_hit = sum(!is.na(best_hit)),
            symbol = sum(SYMBOL != GENEID),
            GO = sum(GO_n > 0))

n_distinct(go$GO)
```
